commands: if [ -z "$CID" ]; then echo NO_CONTAINER; exit 0; fi

docker exec "$CID" python3 -c 'import json,collections; d=json.load(open("/app/config/jobs.json")); jobs=d.get("jobs", d if isinstance(d,list) else []); print("job_count", len(jobs)); print("schedules", dict(collections.Counter(str(j.get("schedule")) for j in jobs))); print("windowMinutes", dict(collections.Counter(j.get("windowMinutes") for j in jobs))); print("windowDays", dict(collections.Counter(j.get("windowDays") for j in jobs))); print("outputFormat", dict(collections.Counter(j.get("outputFormat") for j in jobs))); print("has_filter", sum(1 for j in jobs if j.get("filter"))); print("has_connectionName", sum(1 for j in jobs if j.get("connectionName"))); print("has_configName", sum(1 for j in jobs if j.get("configName")));
[print({k:j.get(k) for k in ["name","schedule","windowMinutes","windowDays","outputFormat","connectionName"]}) for j in jobs[:8]]'
